name: Aldis Lamp
desc: Speak, and a signal lamp sends it in Morse — on screen, in fullscreen, on the phone torch and as a sidetone. Point the camera at a light to read a lamp back. Runs entirely in the browser.

name: Asobi — Board Games
desc: Play Shogi (将棋) — human vs human, human vs AI, or AI vs AI — Hanafuda Koi-Koi (花札) against the computer, and the Pentarch deterministic auto-battler. Runs entirely in your browser.

name: Carino Branding
desc: The living design-system reference — tokens, components and copy-ready snippets for every Carino project.

name: ButterEye
desc: ButterEye makes the videos you play in mpv smoother: new in-between frames, live or as a saved copy. Free software for Fedora Linux, Windows and macOS.

name: Carino Systems
desc: Open solutions made for everyone, free for anyone — open a medical image, fix a document, build a résumé, set up a computer. The web tools need no install and no account, and your files never leave your computer.

name: Compass
desc: A 12-axis political compass measured by intention — Mind, Suggest, Enforce — not number grading. Compare against leaders, thinkers and fictional characters, in 2D or 3D.

name: Carino Currency
desc: Carino Currency — a keyless, in-browser finance watcher: live FX trends and movers, finance news, and export/import trade value. Data from ECB/Frankfurter, GDELT and the World Bank; nothing is uploaded.

name: CVE Database
desc: Search CVE security vulnerabilities from the NIST NVD — CVSS scores, filters and trends, fast and offline-capable, in your browser.

name: CyberCity
desc: Four walkable worlds drawn entirely in text characters — a rain-lit city, an 1880s frontier town, the Moon and a castle town at dusk — with the sun going round.

name: Desk
desc: Help-desk snippet workspace — search, fill in and copy canned replies for support tickets, in your browser.

name: Carino DICOM Editor
desc: Inspect and modify X-ray metadata tags for HIPAA compliance and PACS interoperability.

name: Find Me a Distro
desc: Pick a Linux or BSD family and get one of its distros at random, with a link to its site. A random pick, not a match; your choices stay in the link.

name: Fiscal
desc: An offline card that holds your fiscal identity — personal and business — for every jurisdiction you file in. Check digits validated on device, spelled out phonetically for the counter, and never sent anywhere.

name: Carino Fonts
desc: Make fonts in your browser: pixel and vector glyph editing, kerning, live preview, TTF/WOFF export and subsetting. Everything stays on your machine.

name: Hardware
desc: Decode a MAC address to its vendor and bits, jump to any brand's warranty & driver pages, and get feature-first hardware build recommendations. Runs entirely in your browser.

name: Hash
desc: A course in how hashing works: modules by hash family, step-by-step labs that walk through each round, and progress kept in your browser.

name: Jellyfish
desc: A moon jelly, swimming. Ambient WebGL.

name: Kanban
desc: A free Kanban board with no account and no server: the whole board lives in its link, so you can bookmark it or share it.

name: Law — Official Sources
desc: A directory of where law is officially published, country by country: the gazette of record, the constitution, the consolidated statutes, the courts and the treaties, each linked at the body that publishes it. The sources that are not official say so.

name: Carino Learn
desc: Carino Learn: hands-on, checkable learning modules with interactive visualizers — x86-64 assembly, PC architecture, Bash, GNU tools, Linux administration, Git & version control, networking, netplan declarative network configuration, web browsers, regex, cryptography, quantum computing, DICOM & HL7 healthcare interoperability, and ISO 27001 compliance.

name: Media Suite
desc: Client-side file & media suite: PDF to images, OCR, signature cleanup, image conversion, ffmpeg command builder and audio to WAV. Everything runs in your browser.

name: Metadata
desc: See every piece of metadata in almost any file, edit EXIF, PDF and MP3 tags, and strip GPS location from photos — in your browser. Your files are never uploaded.

name: Music Wall
desc: A personal music wall and per-country collection. Click any cover to play, browse by country, queue songs and follow along with synced lyrics.

name: Netplan Configurator
desc: Build Linux network configs without YAML mistakes — netplan, systemd-networkd and NetworkManager files generated in your browser.

name: Carino Offline
desc: What to download before you can't, which software still works with the WAN cable pulled, what the hardware costs in Mexico, and how physical media beats a blocked route. Runs entirely in your browser, offline.

name: Password
desc: Make a strong password, and send it to someone safely. Everything happens in your browser.

name: Ping
desc: Client-side latency measurement and ping log analysis: round trip, jitter, packet loss and the DNS/TLS/TTFB split from your browser, or any saved ping output read in the tab. Nothing leaves the page.

name: Quote
desc: Make a clean price quote for your services or products and export it to PDF — free, in your browser, no account.

name: DLSS 5 for Linux
desc: DLSS 5 for Linux puts NVIDIA's DLSS 5 neural rendering into Steam games running under Proton, and runs the same model over your pictures and videos. Free software for Fedora and any recent Linux.

name: Carino Retina
desc: Eye examination, refraction & dispensing suite — annotate a fundus for an automatic cup-to-disc ratio, refract, work up a spectacle/CL dispense, and export a study PDF, DICOM, prescription or lens order.

name: Carino Setup
desc: One command that configures Linux, Windows or macOS: hardware and distribution detection, drivers, and 15 purpose profiles. Nothing to install first.

name: Software Catalogue
desc: Straight download links and install commands for software and operating systems — Linux, Windows and macOS — in one searchable catalog.

name: Stocks
desc: Client-side markets watchlist, portfolio and alerts. Your keys, your device. Monitoring only, never advice.

name: Sync Studio
desc: Fix out-of-sync subtitles and lyrics: shift, stretch and re-time .srt, .lrc and .ass files and preview them, in your browser.

name: TelePrompter
desc: A free online teleprompter: paste your script, set the speed and read, with mirror mode for teleprompter glass.

name: Carino Test
desc: Carino Test — a complete in-browser network and system diagnostics suite: WAN/LAN, NAT and WebRTC topology, DNS-over-HTTPS, latency, speed, and a live reachability sweep of the top 50 websites in the world.

name: Time
desc: Local time, UTC and Unix epoch — a searchable world-clock with pinned zones, live stock-market opening hours, plus countdowns you can add and share.

name: Topo
desc: Draw network diagrams in your browser — devices, links and IP addressing on an interactive canvas, shared as a private link.

name: TV
desc: Watch many live news streams from around the world at once. Add YouTube or any embeddable stream, organize by country, and share your wall with a link.

name: Vitae
desc: Build a clean, print-ready résumé with live editing and PDF export. Your data stays in your browser.

name: Carino DICOM
desc: A self-hosted DICOM gateway and continuity appliance: receives, routes, forwards and de-identifies studies, answers Query/Retrieve and DICOMweb, and serves an emergency worklist when the PACS is down. Not a medical device, not for primary diagnosis.

name: Carino Images
desc: Purpose-built Fedora: six COSMIC + Hyprland desktops and two headless appliances — Asterisk/FreePBX telephony and an intranet keystone for a LAN with no working WAN — each shipping the integration one kind of work needs. Installer ISO or bootc container image.
